explanation.headline: FDA's records trace this shortage to a plant on our own labels

sentences.text: The product label for alprazolam (NDC 65862067799) identifies Aurobindo Pharma Limited (FEI 3007373532) as the registered manufacturing plant.
FDA inspection 1105823 of that plant ended on 2019-09-27 and was classified Official Action Indicated (OAI), with the classification known to FDA on 2019-12-26.
A subsequent inspection (1169446) ended on 2022-05-10 and was classified Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI), known to FDA on 2022-08-04.
Current inventory across the three Corvale sites provides 20 to 27 days on hand at present usage rates.
The recommended action is to purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and operates the Amneal Pharmaceuticals of NY plant.

rejected.text: That OAI classification occurred 2562 days before the shortage posting date of 2026-10-21.
FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 2562 days before the posting

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-402a55.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%alprazolam%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%alprazolam%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-3e7e8f.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('d2fd0b3e-9b78-44d0-82a6-96d6c6238750') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-93d7fc.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%alprazolam%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-85798a.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%alprazolam%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-7c1058.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%alprazolam%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%tablet%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-207444.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3007373532', '3004021229', '3003294404') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-7d2540.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3007373532', '3004021229', '3003294404') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-467a0d.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3007373532') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('aurobindo')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-ea4d9e.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('aurobindo') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%alprazolam%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-5a012b.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('1105823') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-eab774.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('65862067799')
